ops.text: 14a. TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content, Client Proprietary Information and other data of Client in TrueLink's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all such Client Content, Client Proprietary Information and data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement gives us no exit rights, so we have added a transition and data-return paragraph: up to six months of assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiration or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can work with 90 days of assistance provided the 30-day export remains.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 14a requiring transition assistance, return of Client data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion.
